phases.title: Census 2027 happens in two phases
phases.subtitle: The census is conducted in two separate visits to your home.
phases.phase1Desc: Focuses mainly on houses, households, housing conditions, amenities and household assets.
phases.phase2Desc: Focuses on information about people living in households.

whatIsCensus.title: What is Census?
whatIsCensus.description: The Census is a national survey that collects basic information about people and households. It helps the government understand our country's needs and plan for a better future. It is completely safe and confidential.
